name: 크몽

buyer.notes: secondary source, not confirmed on the official page

fees.notes: Seller tiers apply to each order amount; category rates vary (모형 제작 changed 2026-10-16). A business seller lists prices including the fee and VAT.

bidCost.notes: No bidding. Ads (CPC, 클릭업, 스마트픽) are paid with 비즈머니.

splitMechanism: No native milestones. A partial payment is a new order for the partial amount; an old order can only be cancelled in full. Splitting payments to inflate sales is a banned 부정 거래.

contactPolicy.notes: No phone, e-mail, SNS or URL in the profile, service pages, images or pre-order messages, and no pre-order meetings or Zoom links. After an order, contact goes through 크몽 메시지 or 안심번호.

payout: Withdrawal requests 18:00 to 12:00 next day KST, paid in 1 to 2 business days after 구매 확정.

automation.officialAutoReply: 자동응답 with up to 5 Q&A pairs, visible to buyers in the app; 자주 쓰는 문구 and 야간 응답 제외 also exist. Auto-replies do not count toward response metrics.
forbidden: auto-reply content that lures off-platform payment
fake orders to move the grade
split payments to inflate sales data
changing a service first-level category after approval
automation.notes: No bot or scraping clause was found in the fetched 운영정책 sections (unknown); treat anything outside official features as banned.

aiPolicy: AI use is allowed. Hiding AI use or presenting AI output as human-made is deceptive advertising under 표시광고법; AI virtual persons are labelled 가상인물; deepfakes and illegal synthetic content are banned.
taxInvoice: Business sellers (일반과세, 법인) issue 세금계산서 on buyer request through 홈택스; 크몽 auto-issues reverse invoices for 품질보장 and Prime orders when a 공동인증서 is registered, and invoices its own commission monthly.
limitsNotes: listing is the service description cap shown on the gig edit form (20000, minimum 100); FAQ and request fields there are 255 each. Message, quote and profile caps were not observed. proposal is the enterprise 제안하기 form, which renders only after the enterprise profile is registered; propose() refuses a text longer than the field's maxLength it reads.

enterprise.notes: 크몽 엔터프라이즈 projects (/enterprise/requests) are brokered contracts: the fee is 13.2% of the total contract amount, charged when the contract is concluded, in place of the per-order seller tiers. Proposing needs an enterprise profile (/enterprise/seller/profile) with a resume PDF and a portfolio entry; the daily proposal quota shows on /seller/proposals.

rankingSignals: first response within 24 hours on at least 90% of the last 60 inquiries keeps the grade; below drops it to NEW
average reply within 10 minutes earns the 빠른 응답 badge
grade uses sales count and amount, satisfaction, order success rate, deadline adherence and penalty history
